summary: Kennedy Lewis Capital Company filed an 8-K under Items 1.01/1.02/9.01 to report a routine change in custodian and a related amendment to its existing credit facility. On July 1, 2026, the company replaced State Street Bank and Trust Company with U.S. Bank Trust Company as custodian, document custodian, collateral agent, and securities intermediary. An amendment to the Secured Credit Facility was also entered to effect these substitutions. No financial terms, premiums, or strategic changes were disclosed. This is an administrative service-provider transition, not a special situation. Watch for no further action; the risk-arb angle is nil.
